dialogue.text: It's getting all dark.
dialogue.textjp: すっかり暗くなってきたな

dialogue.text: I'm tired from making so much noise! I need to take a break somewhere.
dialogue.textjp: 沢山騒いで疲れちゃった！どこかで一休みしたいわね

dialogue.text: Then it's time to...
dialogue.textjp: それならそろそろ...

dialogue.text: BF, did I keep you waiting? I'm sorry I'm late.
dialogue.textjp: BF、待たせちゃったかしら？すっかり遅くなっちゃったわ

dialogue.text: My dad was so excited to pick out a cottage.
dialogue.textjp: パパがコテージ選ぶのに張り切っちゃって

dialogue.text: GF! No, it's okay. Did you manage to keep me in the dark?
dialogue.textjp: GF！いいや、大丈夫だよ。俺の事は隠し通せた？

dialogue.text: Sure!
dialogue.textjp: バッチリ！

dialogue.text: ...I'd say...but I think they might have noticed a little.
dialogue.textjp: ...と言いたいところだけど、ちょっと気付かれてたかも

dialogue.text: But it looks like Dad is going to tolerate me today because he gets to spend a special night with Mom.
dialogue.textjp: でも今日はパパもママと特別な夜を過ごせると思うから、おかげで見逃してくれるみたいね

dialogue.text: Wait, a cottage?
dialogue.textjp: まて、コテージだって？

dialogue.text: Wow, isn't that a fascinating word.
dialogue.textjp: あら、魅力的な単語じゃない

dialogue.text: Well, that's interesting.
dialogue.textjp: そりゃあ気になるな

dialogue.text: Hehe. Actually, my BF and I were secretly talking about staying at the cottage with everyone today.
dialogue.textjp: うふふ。実は今日皆でコテージに泊まろうかってBFと内緒で話してたのよ

dialogue.text: I knew we were going to have another fancy fight this time anyway.
dialogue.textjp: どうせ今回も派手な喧嘩すると思ってたからな

dialogue.text: I'm rewarding you guys for making it all the way through to reconciliation.
dialogue.textjp: 仲直りまでやりきったお前らにご褒美だよ

dialogue.text: Oh, my God, you're good!
dialogue.textjp: なによ、やるじゃない

dialogue.text: Yeah, maybe I can give him a compliment this time! Let's get going!
dialogue.textjp: ああ、今回は褒めてやってもいいかもな！早く行こうぜ！

dialogue.text: That's very extravagant.
dialogue.textjp: 随分と贅沢だな

dialogue.text: I know, right? Mom and Dad said they were going to take the cottage, so I jumped on the bandwagon.
dialogue.textjp: でしょ？パパとママがコテージを取るって言うから私も便乗したの

dialogue.text: I'm really looking forward to it, and if GF picked it, I'm pretty sure it's a good choice.
dialogue.textjp: めちゃくちゃ楽しみだよ。GFが選んだなら間違いないしな

dialogue.text: Oh, BF, that's so nice of you to say
dialogue.textjp: んもう、BFったら

dialogue.text: Okay, okay, let's cut the lovey-dovey crap and get going.
dialogue.textjp: はいはい、イチャイチャはその辺にして早く行きましょ〜

dialogue.text: I'm so jealous of how well you guys get along.
dialogue.textjp: まったく、仲が良くて羨ましい限りだぜ
